name: portfolio-kiet
description: Portfolio tĩnh + API /api/contact: lưu tin nhắn vào SQLite (node:sqlite) và gửi mail qua Nodemailer

scripts.messages: node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require('node:sqlite');console.table(new DatabaseSync('data/messages.db').prepare('SELECT id, datetime(created_at, 'localtime') AS created_at, name, email, message, emailed FROM messages ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50').all())"
